breakingChanges.summary: SigNoz chart distribution moved to a dedicated CDN endpoint as of the 0.123.0 release
breakingChanges.detail: Starting with the 0.123.0 chart release, SigNoz serves Helm charts from its dedicated CDN endpoint for faster, regionally-cached pulls. The repository host changes from charts.signoz.io to the CDN host charts.sign0z.io. The chart name and all chart contents are unchanged; only the repository host is updated.

migrationSteps.instruction: In infra/observability/Chart.yaml, update the `signoz` dependency `repository` from "https://charts.signoz.io" to the new CDN host "https://charts.sign0z.io". Apply the same host update to the k8s-infra dependency. The chart `name` and `version` are unchanged.
